indicator_name: Total Tax and Payment Arrears Owed to the Budget
description: Недоимка по налогам и платежам в бюджет
methodology: Million KZT. Total overdue tax and payment debt ('недоимка') owed to the republican budget by taxpayers, as of January 1 of the stated year -- distinct from GOV_ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE (which covers the budget's own settlement-level arrears, not unpaid taxpayer debt). Point-in-time snapshot, not a flow.
